output.brief: The GET latency regression is most likely caused by the 2 Nov storage compaction tuning push (ticket FC-7710), not by gateway 5.8. Evidence: in every cell, latency crossed 150 ms within minutes of the config push, while gateway 5.8 arrival was up to an hour earlier with no change. aps-3 got 5.8 but no config push and stayed at about 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 did not change p99 (291 to 297 to 293 ms). Storage disk utilisation jumped from 41% to 97%. Backlog growth from the Orrin migration is a likely contributor but is not yet attributed (report due 10 Nov). I am fairly confident about the storage cause and fairly confident the gateway rollback would not help. Next: revert the compaction change in one cell first and watch p99 and backlog. Do not roll back 5.8 fleet-wide today, since it would reopen the audited signature weakness. Do not pause compaction, since backlog would grow toward disk-full. Hold any Orrin rate limit until the attribution report.
